objective: Harden the public supervised self-hosting seam for packages/pi-autoresearch without widening into hidden daemonization, package-local self-promotion, or direct AK mutation.

notes: The first actual evaluator bundle is source-inspection-only by design.

Candidate worktrees do not automatically inherit ignored package-local node_modules trees, so runtime execution must not be faked through hidden dependency hydration or candidate-owned package-manager judge selection.

suites.intent: Ensure the candidate extension still exposes the public self-hosting seam and the new start_and_watch action.
Ensure README-level operator guidance still advertises the bounded self-hosting seam honestly.
Ensure runtime help/status surfaces continue to advertise the self-hosting seam and its guardrails.
Ensure package-local current-vs-target truth still records start_and_watch and bounded non-goals.
